decisions: Pakar Belia School (ID440) became a recognised centre after this series; its candidates were entered under Pribadi Bandung (ID350). Those rows are attributed to ID440.
Candidates missing a component have no syllabus total and no grade. They are counted as incomplete entries and excluded from every mean and grade distribution.

AS Level grades (lower-case a-e) and full A Level grades (upper-case A*-E) are reported separately, never pooled. Grade U is upper case for both and the report gives no way to attribute it, so it forms a third bucket rather than being counted as a failed A Level.
Centre ID244 is Semesta Gunung Pati. The semesta.sch.id domain is shared with Semesta Jangli, so the centre number is the only reliable key.
IGCSE Core and Extended candidates are separated by the papers they sat (Papers 1/3 Core, 2/4 Extended). Core is capped at grade C, so pooling the tiers understates a school.
